coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Okta

Dear Hiring Manager,

A newly formed organization needs budgeting and forecasting it can trust from the start, and that means a model built around what actually drives the business. At Calder Industrial Components I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. When I rebuilt the larger unit's model around order backlog, forecast accuracy rose from 88% to 96%.

As a Financial Analyst with 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I've done much of what your ad describes: budget vs. actual variance analysis, evaluating key drivers and partnering with operational leaders on their numbers. I also shortened month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, and I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers. That is the combination of advanced Excel, process improvement and clear reporting your Technology FP&A role calls for. My B.S. in Finance is complete, and I've passed 9 of 13 ACCA papers. I haven't worked in SaaS or on M&A, but I learn fast and I'm used to challenging how a process runs. At Calder that meant rebuilding the forecast rather than patching it.

Supporting a two-day-in-office rhythm in San Francisco alongside senior leadership, while the team scales, is the kind of pace I want to work at. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help Okta's Technology organization plan and forecast with precision, and I'm available to speak at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
